command: cd validation && uv run python pkg/bilayer_plate.py

targets.locator: validation/pkg/bilayer_plate.py clt() (equals timoshenko() with biaxial moduli to round-off)

targets.definition: u_z(x2) - u_z(x1) on the bottom = (d2w/dr2) (x2^2 - x1^2) / 2
targets.locator: validation/pkg/bilayer_plate.py clt() (equals timoshenko() with biaxial moduli to round-off)
